ranking_rationale: Ranked by information gained per bounded run, then scientific merit, then independence. 1-3 could change a load-bearing quantity or convert a published bound into an exact number. 4-5 sharpen an already-reported decision quantity. 6-7 add new primary evidence through the admitted PubMed/PMC route, cheap but may return not-retrievable. 8-9 open evidence surfaces never touched by the campaign: high expected information, high variance. 10 is consolidation, creating a reusable object rather than a new fact.
global_fences_applied: no wet lab; no EMC efficacy, safety, selectivity, therapeutic-window or clinical-readiness claim anywhere
no GPU, no paid API, no large download; every proposal runs on committed inputs or admitted PubMed/PMC MCP calls
routes B1, B2, B4, B8, B9 remain closed; R1/R4 closed duplicates; R2 and R3 unadmitted; no relabelling reopens any of them
direct HTTP egress is proxy-refused (CONNECT 403 / curl exit 56) and is not attempted
no publication act, no outreach, no new manuscript-admission authority
user-rejected EMC-classification project off limits; retired patient-facing site not recreated; frozen ASO and submitted assets not edited
MF1 and P-ST are ACCEPTED/CLOSED and do not appear
no guard, floor, gate, matcher, pin or test weakened; no fabricated exit code; a skipped test is not a pass; every failed execution preserved
writes confined to each proposal's own new lane directory; shared-file changes are unapplied diffs only

proposals.title: Composition-adjusted EMC expression contrast
proposals.question: Is the broad two-platform EMC expression contrast tumour/stroma composition, or EMC biology?
proposals.what_is_new: KINASE-2 (../KINASE-2/FINDING.md sec.8 item 1) proved the 65.2% concordance is a real shared EMC contrast and left this as the sharply defined open alternative. KINASE-2 computed label-permutation and gene-resampling nulls; it did not adjust for or stratify on sample composition. No lane has.

inputs.note: gene_reads 479 genes with per-sample z_vs_array and class labels for both series; signature_member_reads 42-GSM z matrix; 22 of 25 probed composition markers present (verified checks/03)
reused read-only as the known-answer gate

proposals.artifact: composition-adjusted-contrast.json - per lead gene and frame: unadjusted statistic, composition score, rank-based composition-adjusted statistic, attenuation; marker list frozen before any statistic is read

ownership.write_conflict: none - KINASE-2 is complete and is read read-only; nothing outside the new directory is written

proposals.validation: Known answer first: recompute KINASE-2's observed statistics, require 0 mismatches, exit 2 otherwise. Negative control: a permuted composition score must not attenuate. Marker list and seed pre-registered in the lane before running.
proposals.stop_condition: Stop when the adjusted statistic and its null are computed on the primary and secondary frames, or immediately on a reproduction failure - whichever comes first.
proposals.compute_storage: stdlib + numpy; one 13 MB JSON read; under 2 min CPU; under 5 MB written; no network
proposals.risks: Attenuation is a statement about this contrast only; never an efficacy or target claim.
